MoltenGram is a powerful, privacy-first, and highly customizable Telegram client based on Exteraless with native Material Design 3 aesthetics.

Key features:
• Media Carousel: browse grouped photos and videos in a smooth horizontal card carousel instead of a grid.
• Material Design 3 & Material You: dynamic Monet palette, custom avatar shapes per chat type, modern chip folders, and fluid text input animations.
• MetroList Audio Player: full-screen modern music player with synchronized lyrics from multiple providers.
• Built-in Plugin Store: install and update Python plugins directly in one click.
• Shizuku Silent Updates: background app updates without manual package installer prompts.
• Over 20 unique launcher icons with monochrome Nothing OS and Google Pixel support.
• Fastest Proxy: auto-ping test and seamless connection to the fastest proxy server.
• Complete privacy: no third-party trackers, analytics, or ads.
